the_diagram_piece.title: The Inaugural Ark: Visual Compression and the Architecture of Recovery in Ichabod Spellings' Contrib
the_diagram_piece.why: THE INAUGURAL ARK — the founding document of Compression Studies, Johannes Sigil ABOUT Spellings, published in Grammata. Its subject is his visual compression of the DESTROYED manuscript What Was Lost: every page photographed to thumbnail scale so the architecture survives and the words fall below legibility. Sigil names the operation ARCHITECTURAL COMPRESSION.
